fullName: TJWA_TC_UTRCB_NEG_001 - [Negative] Invalid mobile number blocks submission
description:
[Negative] Verify submitting the used tractor request call back form with an invalid (too-short) mobile number does not succeed.

Expected: The form should remain open and should not reach the thank-you/success state when the mobile number is invalid.
